gloss: to push through; to part (a crowd)

definitions.gloss: to push through; to part; to shove aside
definitions.explanation: To push or sweep things aside with the hands or body in order to move forward, as through a crowd, undergrowth, or branches.

examples.japanese: {人|ひと}ごみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かき{分|わ}けて⟦{進|すす}んだ→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: I pushed through the crowd and moved forward.

examples.japanese: ⟦{草|くさ}→草：02206_kusa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かき{分|わ}けて⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}した→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I parted the grass and searched for the path.

examples.japanese: ⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{群衆|ぐんしゅう}→群衆：14930_gunshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かき{分|わ}けて⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{近|ちか}づこう→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧とした。
examples.english: The reporters tried to push through the crowd to get close to the player.

notes:
Compound of かく (to rake, to sweep) + ⟦{分|わ}ける→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧ (to divide). Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧): the thing pushed aside is marked with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {人|ひと}ごみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かき{分|わ}ける: to push through a crowd
- ⟦{草木|くさき}→草木：14089_kusaki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かき{分|わ}ける: to part the vegetation
- かき{分|わ}けて⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: to push one's way forward
- かき{分|わ}けて⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧: to force one's way through

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{押|お}しのける→押しのける：15778_oshinokeru⟧: to shove aside — pushes a single obstacle out of the way, more forceful
- ⟦{掻|か}き{回|まわ}す→掻き回す：09915_kakimawasu⟧: to stir up; to churn — the かく element, but mixing rather than parting
